title: Interteam contracts and failure-mode simulation lab
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Reduce surprise cross-team regressions during quarter cutovers by defining lightweight interteam contracts for roadmap handoffs and exercising them continuously via a failure-mode simulation lab. This initiative builds a small, repeatable simulation harness + visualizations so Eng/Design/Security/Infra can validate assumptions (latency, auth surface, rollout windows, migration steps) before commit windows. The deliverables are: 1) a minimal contract schema (API surface, SLAs, compatibility matrix, rollback signal), 2) a dependency catalog with tagging and ownership, 3) a simulation harness that can inject failures (quota loss, region outage, model fallback) and replay traffic against staging infra, 4) a console dashboard surfacing contract health and simulation run results, and 5) a handoff/runbook template to embed in PRs and initiative docs. Success measures map to OKRs: reduce blocked cutovers by 40% (Q2), decrease cross-team last-minute change chatter by 30% (measured in interlock meetings), and catch at least one high-severity compatibility issue per simulation run on average.
acceptance_criteria: Contract schema reviewed and approved by Eng, Design, Security, and Infra
Dependency catalog populated for top 30 active initiatives with explicit owners and tags
Simulation harness can run three predefined scenarios (auth failure, model fallback, regional latency spike) against staging and produce deterministic results
Dashboard surfaces simulation status, recent failures, and per-contract health with drillthrough to failing traces/diffs
Handoff template integrated into initiative PR checklist and used in at least two upcoming cutovers
